reasons.text: The widened crossover needs no visibility splay: Kestrel Lane is a 20 mph street with no through traffic and the highway authority has confirmed the waiver in writing.
With the garage converted, the two side-by-side drive spaces and the cycle store meet Table T2.1 for a four-bedroom house.

citations.quote: The authority confirms the visibility splay requirement can be waived for this crossover.
Parking after works: two spaces side by side on the drive; cycle store in the rear garden
